reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects the web_search tool to Tavily Search API, handling credential lookup, result normalization, cancellation, and provider errors.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_search 工具连接到 Tavily Search API，并规范化返回的搜索结果。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness's web_search tool to the Tavily Search API and normalizes returned search results.

capabilities: Performs web searches through the Tavily Search API
Sends configured search queries to an external service
Uses a configured API credential reference
Normalizes search results and answers for the DSH web_search tool
Supports request cancellation and reports provider errors
